name: Jarvis Send Step (SAFE BY DEFAULT, DRY_RUN)

nodes.name: Recheck and decide
nodes.notes: DRY_RUN = true ships here. While true, nothing is sent and nothing is set to Sent; rows are only logged as 'would send'. Joshua flips it at go-live (see SEND.md).

nodes.name: Send (DISABLED)
nodes.notes: PLACEHOLDER, DISABLED ON PURPOSE. Joshua must replace this node with his real sender (email/SMS/post) and enable it, and only after the go-live checklist in SEND.md. The replacement must output the incoming fields plus send_ok = true on success only (and no send_ok on failure). A disabled node passes items through without send_ok, so nothing is ever marked Sent by accident.
